$comment: Copy to config.json in this directory (git-ignored) or to ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/repo-sync/config.json. Accounts matter only for HTTPS remotes: their fetch gets GH_TOKEN from gh auth token -u <login>. SSH remotes use your ssh config and never get a token. repo-sync never switches the active gh account. reportChanges lists repos (Orca display name, folder name, or owner/repo) whose pulls print the new commits and changed paths; default tiger-team-sync.

accounts.$comment: Work account: every repo under these owners, plus one repo elsewhere. A repos entry wins over another account's owners entry.
Personal account: no owners or repos means every repo not claimed above. At most one account may be unscoped.
